prompt:
Image 1 is the finished sheet; image 2 is its layout: 2 building outlines seen from above on flat magenta, in a 2×1 grid. Redraw only cell 2, the right one (the transparent area). Keep cell 1 exactly as it is, and match its style, colours and fine detail.

The fault in cell 2: the roof was drawn about 10% too narrow — its right edge stops about 25 px short of the outline's right edge, leaving a gap. The roof now fills its outline in image 2 exactly, edge to edge, left to right and top to bottom, with its parapet on every edge of the outline. Each stairwell exit box is seen straight down: its flat top only, about 2.5 × 3 m, no door and no wall face visible.

Trace the outline in image 2 exactly, keep its proportions, straight square edges, top-down with no perspective, and keep the magenta background flat pure #FF00FF outside it. Details at true size: a building next to cars 4 m long; a vent stack about 0.6 m, a TV antenna about 2 m across, a parapet about 0.3 m thick. No text.

2. 11.7 × 43.6 m (3.7× deeper than wide, a thin strip) — five-storey Soviet brick or panel block, flat roof of dark grey bitumen membrane, 2 stairwell exit hatches and vent stacks evenly along the ridge line, TV antennas, standing narrow end to the street with the entrance on that short front wall, its ridge running from the street to the back
